item.title: Week 10: 49ers at Cowboys
item.description: Sun 11/15 · 4:25 PM ET | Line: SF -4.5 · O/U 55.5 | Model DAL 41% vs. market 36% | On paper, San Francisco has the edge, led by its passing offense ranking 5th of 32 in EPA per dropback (+0.25), while Dallas counters with the 4th-best pressure rate in the league at 23%, versus San Francisco's 21% from 3rd. Brock Purdy ranks 4th of 31 among quarterbacks in EPA per dropback, ahead of Dak Prescott at 7th of 31, and the x-factor is CeeDee Lamb, who draws 35% of Dallas' targets and 43% of its air yards, with a WOPR of 0.79 ranking 4th of 108 against a San Francisco pass defense ranked 6th. The model also favors San Francisco at a 59% win probability, driven mainly by the passing matchup (1.9 points) and the rushing matchup (1.2 points).
